slides.label: Bhrigu Nandi Nadi
slides.title: Read the signs
body:
An old way to read a chart,
named for the sage Bhrigu and Nandi
Look at the sign each graha sits in
Then see who sits with whom

body: Two grahas in one sign live together

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Who shares your room?
items: A coach who pushes you, a lawyer who fights
Love that starts slow and lasts
Words that charm: sales, design, the first text
